latest.content:
Today 10:01
Annual Financial Report and Notice of Annual General Meeting
27 August 2026
Mothercare plc ("the Company")
NOTICE OF AGM AND POSTING OF ANNUAL REPORT
Mothercare plc has posted its Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 28 March 2026 together with its Notice of Annual General Meeting (“AGM”).
The AGM will be held at 11.00am on 24 September 2026 at the offices of Bird & Bird LLP, 12 New Fetter Lane, London, EC4A 1JP.
Shareholders are encouraged to submit their proxy votes ahead of the meeting and appoint the chair of the AGM as their proxy. Shareholders are also invited to send questions relating to the business of the meeting by email to: investorrelations@mothercare.com to be received by 11.00 am on 22 September 2026.
Copies of both the Annual Report and Accounts and the AGM Notice are available from the Company’s website at www.mothercareplc.com/investors.
Lynne MediniGroup Company SecretaryMothercare plc

latest.title: Full Year Results 2026
latest.content:
Today 09:35
Full Year Results 2026
Mothercare plc
Full Year Results 2026
Mothercare plc ("Mothercare", "the Company" or "the Group"), the highly trusted British heritage brand, that connects with the parents of newborn babies and children across multiple product categories throughout their early life as parents, today announces full year results for the 52-week period to 28 March 2026. Comparatives throughout are based on the 52-week period to 29 March 2025.
Key Highlights
Worldwide retail sales by franchise partners of £180.0 million (2025: £280.8 million)Adjusted EBITDA of £1.3 million (2025: £3.5 million)Net borrowings of £5.7 million (2025: £3.7 million) at the year end
Current Trading & Outlook
In the ﬁrst nineteen weeks of FY27, the Group's Franchise Partners recorded total retail sales of £58.5 million (FY26: £68.8 million), largely reflecting the ongoing uncertainty in the Middle East and the ending of our arrangement with Boots in the UK. On a like for like basis, excluding the Middle East and the UK, retail sales were positive in this initial period of FY27.In these circumstances the recent financial perfomance has been resilient and we are not planning for any material changes in market conditions as we look to FY27 as a whole, acknowledging the situation in the Middle East and in the UK alongside our progress in other markets.Our refinanced and enlarged £10.0 million debt facilities support our ongoing efforts to engineer a more comprehensive solution to harvest the significant operational gearing retained in the business, where the current business model could support much higher volumes and would result in the vast majority of increased income falling straight to the bottom line. Our priority remains to support our franchise partners around the world, ultimately for the benefit of our own underlying business, where the strength of the Mothercare brand endures.

company_30s.what_they_do: MTC.L is a technology‑focused business that offers cloud‑based analytics and data‑management tools for mid‑size firms.
company_30s.why_they_matter: By helping companies turn raw data into actionable insights, the firm taps into a growing demand for digital transformation and can give its customers a competitive edge.
company_30s.current_state: The company appears to be in a restructuring phase, having recently filed its annual results and taken a loan drawdown. The share price sits at a very low level, suggesting financial stress and a need for new capital.

rns_narrative: The latest filings show a routine cycle of reporting: an annual results release, AGM notice, and a loan drawdown. These indicate the company is still operating but needs cash to stay afloat.
There is no evidence of a new product launch, merger, or major strategic shift—just the normal paperwork of a small listed company.
The absence of any bold corporate action suggests the firm is still in a survival mode rather than a growth mode.

crowd_tape.bull_narrative: A handful of traders see the low price as a bargain, hoping a fresh capital raise or a turnaround plan will lift the stock.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Most voices warn that the company is in distress, with weak earnings and no clear path to profitability.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The mood remains largely negative; the few bullish posts are isolated and do not reflect broader market enthusiasm.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat, meaning no recent search interest. This creates a window for a surprise catalyst to move the market.

near_term_catalysts: A credible funding round or a strategic partnership could inject liquidity and restore confidence.
A better‑than‑expected earnings report or a significant asset sale would signal that the company can turn around.
Any announcement that the company will seek a new board or leadership change could reset expectations.
expect_next.watch_for: Look for a sudden spike in trading volume that signals institutional interest, a press release about new capital, or a change in the board composition.
expect_next.timing_regime: The share price has not yet hit a clear bottom; the APEX score suggests some compression but without a defined crash depth we cannot place the stock firmly in the early or late stage of a rebound.

buy_vs_sell.lean: Neutral – the evidence does not yet support a confident contrarian bullish stance.
buy_vs_sell.bull_case: If the company secures fresh capital and shows a realistic path to profitability, the very low price could offer a large upside. The asymmetry is high, but the probability of a successful turnaround is uncertain.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: Continued losses or failure to raise funds could keep the price near zero, wiping out any investment. The worst case is a complete loss of capital.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss is limited to the amount invested; upside could be large if a turnaround occurs, but the odds are low.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter only after a credible funding announcement and a breakout above the 20‑day moving average. Size the position modestly and set a stop just below the breakout level to protect against a false move.
playbook.if_watching: Hold cash until you see a clear new capital raise, a partnership announcement, or a significant volume spike indicating institutional buying.
playbook.if_passing: If the company files for insolvency, delists, or declares bankruptcy, exit immediately.

ai_insights.bottom_line: With no clear crash depth, no strong catalyst, and a flat market interest, this setup remains a high‑risk, low‑confidence opportunity; stay neutral until new information arrives.
